CC: Auto Response (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows how to create an auto response in the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration (CC) Mobile Application for iOS. |
| :---: |

| Auto Response: In the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration application, navigate to the main menu. Select Auto Response. Toggle Auto Response on to set the end date and time.  Click Save to set the end date and time. Enter a custom auto-response or select from the auto-response options.  NOTE: *If you wish to turn off Auto Response earlier than the set end date and time, navigate back to Auto Response and toggle the feature off.  ![][image1]*  |  |
